purpose: Teach: 特急/合戦/乗り物/ヘルメット/反則/力士/バスケットボール/ハイキング

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、特急、絶対、で、絶対、来たわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm telling you — I got here on the express train, no joke.
lines.style: Bright, animated delivery. Quick attack on the opening. Conspiratorial energy, like she's excitedly reporting back. Gestures with her words. Light, natural rhythm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、漫画の、絶対、合戦、絶対、シーン、絶対、好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really, really love those battle scenes from manga — you know the kind?
lines.style: Small, earnest voice. Eager without performing it. Leans forward slightly. Genuine warmth underneath — he's trying to share something he cares about with her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、乗り物、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、見に行く?本気で
lines.en: Sho, do you want to go see some new vehicles with your dad? Seriously?
lines.style: Soft, inviting tone. Gentle curiosity underneath. Listens for his answer even as she asks. The question carries real interest — she's including him in something good.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、自転車に、本気で、絶対、ヘルメット、絶対、ちゃんと、絶対、つけてるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I always wear my helmet properly when I ride my bike — I do, I promise.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his voice. Matter-of-fact, almost defensive but not hostile. He's showing her he's being careful, responsible. Small but steady conviction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、本気で、絶対、反則、絶対、絶対、嫌う、絶対、人なのよね
lines.en: Sho, your dad really is the type who hates anything unfair, isn't he?
lines.style: Soft, thoughtful tone. Slight pause before speaking, like she's turning something over. Warm observation — not criticism, just noticing. Gentle realisation in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、テレビで、本気で、絶対、力士、絶対、見たんだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw sumo wrestlers on TV the other day!
lines.style: Bright, bursting with the memory. Quick energy. His voice lights up — he wants to share this discovery. Genuine excitement, child-like but not exaggerated.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、バスケットボール、絶対、習ってるの?本気で
lines.en: Sho, are you actually taking basketball lessons? Really?
lines.style: Curious, gentle inquiry. Slight tilt upward at the question. She's asking because she genuinely wants to know what he's up to. Interest without pressure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんと、本気で、絶対、ハイキング、絶対、行きたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go hiking with Dad sometime…
lines.style: Wistful, eager. Soft trailing at the end — he's expressing a quiet wish, hoping she thinks it's a good idea. Small, sincere voice. Vulnerable in the way children can be.
